tasks.label: deploy
tasks.detail: Deploy Firebase Hosting content including publicly accessible weather images and website assets.

tasks.label: _clean-package
tasks.detail: Delete the previously generated native application image and package output.

tasks.label: _clean-build
tasks.detail: Remove compiled classes and distribution artifacts from previous builds.
tasks.command: if exist out rmdir /s /q out & if exist dist rmdir /s /q dist

tasks.label: _compile
tasks.detail: Compile all Java source files from src into the out directory using project libraries.

tasks.label: _copy-resources-to-out
tasks.detail: Copy application resources such as images, fonts, data files, and configuration files into the build output.

tasks.label: _prepare-dist
tasks.detail: Create the distribution folder and copy all required runtime libraries.

tasks.label: _jar
tasks.detail: Package compiled classes and resources into the executable application JAR.

tasks.label: _jpackage
tasks.detail: Generate a native Windows application image for 8 Bit Weather using jpackage.
tasks.command: jpackage --name "8 Bit Weather" --input dist --main-jar app.jar --main-class Main --icon _launch4j\icon.ico --type app-image --dest package

tasks.label: build-package
tasks.detail: Run the complete build pipeline: clean, compile, package, and generate the native application image.
